spec.description:
Autex Surface Finishes Quietspace combines the broadband acoustic performance
of dual-density Quietspace Panel with high-definition digital UV printing.
Available in realistic stone, concrete, and textural finishes from the Autex
Surface Finishes collection, it replicates heavy, reverberant architectural
surfaces without their cost, weight, or rigidity. Printed with safe, water-based
inks directly onto 100% polyester fibre, it delivers an NRC of 0.85 to 1.00 and
Group 1 fire compliance across walls and ceilings.
features:
Broadband
sound absorption achieving NRC 0.85 (25mm) to 1.00 (50mm, 75mm, 100mm)

Digitally printed with realistic stone, marble, concrete, and textural
finishes

Dual-density polyester construction with compressed face and
cushioned backing

Printed with safe, water-based, UV-cured ink without
reducing acoustic absorption

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705
- 2003 and AS 5637.1

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a
minimum of 45% to 58% recycled PET

Lightweight, impact-resistant, and
seismic-safe alternative to solid stone or precast slabs

Non-toxic,
non-allergenic, non-irritant, with low-VOC emissions

Certified Carbon Neutral
product with third-party verified EPD and Declare Red List Free

install:
Ensure wall or ceiling
substrate is flat, clean, dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the
installation environment for at least 24 hours prior to fitting

Plan stone or
texture pattern alignment across panels before applying adhesive

Apply
recommended contact or high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across the panel
back

Position panel onto substrate, butt joins tightly together, and roll
firmly with a pressure roller

Maintain the protective spun-bond film over
panel face until all messy construction trades finish

Trim perimeter panels
carefully from the face using a straight edge and sharp utility knife on the
offcut side
selection_checklist:
Select finish design from Surface
Finishes Stone (Carrara, Travertine, Statuario, etc.) or Texture (Concrete,
Canvas, etc.) palettes

Confirm panel thickness (25mm for NRC 0.85 or 50mm+
for NRC 1.00)

Confirm total wall or ceiling dimensions (1220mm x 2440mm
sheets)
Specify suitable mounting adhesive (contact adhesive or MS polymer)
Confirm need for aluminium edge trims (Autex Type C profile for 25mm)
accessories: Autex Edging Solutions (Type C profiles for 25mm panels)
limitations: Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or direct water exposure

Do not expose to
concentrated heat sources exceeding 80°C

Recommended for non-contact areas as
printed surface may mark under heavy impact

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Surface Finishes Quietspace pairs the
broadband sound absorption of dual-density Quietspace Panel (NRC 0.85 to 1.00)
with high-definition digital UV printing of natural stone, marble, concrete, and
textural finishes. Available in thicknesses from 25mm to 100mm in 1220mm
x 2440mm sheets, it replicates heavy, reverberant architectural masonry without
structural weight, installation complexity, or acoustic compromise. Achieving
Group 1 fire compliance under AS ISO 9705 and containing up to 58% recycled PET,
it delivers premium, carbon-neutral acoustic control for luxury corporate and
hospitality interiors.
